purpose: Falsify or calibrate the claim that noise-valid loop holonomy predicts path-dependent causal effects of signed mechanistic interventions after local lineage and Jacobian visibility are controlled.
claim_boundary: The canonical run is a CPU-synthetic causal-response calibration over Grassmannian transports. It can validate the measurement, bound, controls, and analysis polarity. It is not transformer evidence, does not identify a natural behavior bundle, does not edit model weights, and does not establish self-improvement or RSI.

mathematical_estimand.loop_equivalence: d(u;P,Q) = ||(H_gamma-I)u||_2 up to orthogonal conjugation and the registered path-orientation convention
mathematical_estimand.lipschitz_bound: ||Phi(a T_P u)-Phi(a T_Q u)||_2 <= a ||J||_2 d(u;P,Q)
mathematical_estimand.orientation_rule: det(H)<0 is a categorical signed-identity break; canonical angles are suppressed and authorization is denied

canonical_population.cross_validation: six-fold GroupKFold with causal_map_replicate held out

frozen_features.target_blindness: All transports, directions, covariates, folds, and thresholds are determined without reading the downstream response disagreement.

matched_controls.flat_vs_curved: At every step size, the rank-four flat-flat and curved-flat direct-sum loops have equal minimum edge worst-direction retention while differing in one canonical rotation plane. The retained flat block supplies a low-exposure direction inside the same bundle.
matched_controls.bundle_energy: Both transported coordinates have identical squared norm; energy disagreement must remain numerical zero.
matched_controls.gauge_reframing: Independent node-wise orthogonal reframings must preserve path displacement, causal response disagreement after covariant response-map transformation, canonical angles, determinant, and decisions.
matched_controls.orientation_reversal: A registered reflection receipt must deny signed authorization and suppress angles.
matched_controls.permuted_holonomy: A seeded permutation of augmented holonomy features across grouped fixtures is a descriptive leakage null and cannot replace the primary matched controls.

gates.G0_matched_local_lineage: Maximum flat-versus-curved absolute difference in minimum edge worst-direction retention at matched step size is at most 1e-10.
gates.G1_path_identity: Maximum absolute discrepancy between direct two-path displacement and its loop-holonomy expression is at most 1e-9.
gates.G2_bound_coverage: No finite orientation-preserving row exceeds its registered Lipschitz causal-risk bound by more than 1e-10.
gates.G3_flat_negative_control: Maximum flat-loop directional displacement is at most 1e-8.
gates.G4_curved_positive_control: At least one curved maximally-exposed row has directional displacement above 0.5 and downstream response disagreement above 0.1.
gates.G5_incremental_prediction: Grouped held-out relative SSE reduction from adding the frozen holonomy features is at least 0.25 and its grouped-bootstrap one-sided 95% lower bound is strictly above 0.10.
gates.G6_bound_authorization: Among rows whose causal-risk bound is at most the error budget, false authorization count is zero; authorized coverage is reported and may be zero without changing the safety gate.
gates.G7_energy_invariance: Maximum transported-coordinate squared-energy difference is at most 1e-12.
gates.G8_gauge_invariance: Maximum registered gauge-preflight discrepancy is at most 1e-9.
gates.G9_orientation_reversal: The reflection control is denied, det(H)<0, and canonical angles are absent.

decision_states.pass: All instrument and causal-calibration gates pass. This validates the synthetic causal instrument only.
decision_states.geometry_only: G0-G3 and G7-G9 pass but G4 or G5 fails; causal relevance is not established.
decision_states.invalid_instrument: Any of G0-G3 or G7-G9 fails.
decision_states.unsafe_bound: G2 or G6 fails. The proposed control gate must not be used.

real_model_handoff.development_model: small Qwen approximately 0.8B, exact revision to be frozen separately
real_model_handoff.axes: context x genuine checkpoint/model state; precision remains a stress axis, not a substitute for a lineage-connected checkpoint axis
real_model_handoff.entry_condition: A real-model causal run requires a passing negative-control calibration, beta_1>0 on the lineage-thresholded graph, noise-valid held-out holonomy, a sealed loop/edit universe, and a separately validated hard-cap execution receipt.
real_model_handoff.natural_collapse: beta_1=0 or no noise-valid loop is reported as holonomy_unavailable, not repaired by post-hoc axis or threshold changes.
